summary: Your aircraft now follows the printed route on charts, even ones that are not drawn to scale.
releaseNotes: On a chart in Charts, your live aircraft now moves along the printed leg between the two fixes you're flying between, and sits on each fix's symbol, not its name.
On charts marked not to scale (most STARs and SIDs), the aircraft no longer drifts off the route between fixes.
